title: feat(scenarios): dataset-card questions name their ask kind, and a round counts every kind
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7UBkcmf1Qy7iEMxarYt8wU)_
Fixes #35113
Fixes #35098
Clause-②: yes (widening) — new optional card key `askKind` on `QuestionSchema` and `DatasetQuestionSchema`; new exports `ASK_KINDS`, `AskKind`, `AskKindSchema`, `questionTurnKind`, `checkAskKinds`, `askTurns`, `askKindCounts` and `AskTurn` (package root); `kindTally`, `kindCell` and `KindTally` (`./runner`); new optional fields `QuestionResult.askKind`, `DatasetQuestionResult.askKind` and `HalfScores.kinds` (`./runner`)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;开源评测里两张问数场景卡(订单到回款、差旅报销)的每道题都标明了题型,每轮问数评测的记录按十种题型分别计数,另外差旅报销卡的建应用说明写清了第二步由哪位财务审批。
- 为什么做:「MCP 二期与问数」专项要求开源卡覆盖托管问数集的十种题型,让问数退化当天在开源仓、零成本被发现;差旅卡那句话含糊,让部分构建把第二步审批派给了财务经理。
- 出错会怎样:只影响评测卡的打分与评测报告,不碰产品代码,可直接撤回;两张卡的指纹变了,评测日序列在此处分段。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

**Card one: the ten ask kinds.** Each question and dataset question of the two open dataset cards (`order_to_cash`, `travel_expense`) now names its ask kind (`askKind`), one of the ten kinds the hosted ask set asks: `count`, `group_sum`, `top_n`, `time_range`, `join`, `owner_latest`, `business_term`, `ambiguous`, `forbidden`, `unanswerable` (D6 = A on #34659: the kinds, never the hosted fixture; no hosted question is copied).

- Premise reading: the card counted only the five dataset questions per card. The ten ordinary questions per card already ask the figure kinds, the `forbidden` leak reading as a member persona, and `unanswerable`. Counted per turn (a question once per persona it lists, as the runner asks it), the two cards already ask every kind at least twice. So no question is added: the change names the kinds, holds them to the cards, and makes a round report them. Adding figure questions also risks the near-miss trap #35544 hit (a lifted word that near-misses a dataset measure).
- Per turn, `forbidden` is read off the card: a turn asked as a persona whose truth is `withheld` is a `forbidden` ask whatever kind the question names.
- The loader (`checkAskKinds`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/ask-kinds.ts`) refuses a kind its question contradicts, at `askKind`: `top_n` needs a `topN` truth, `time_range` an `in_window` filter, `join` a relation path, `group_sum` a `groupBy`, `count` none, `owner_latest` a `groupBy` ending on a person field (a declared lookup to an object a persona's `record` names, such as `employee`, or a declared user-handle field), `business_term` exactly the `metric_selected` dataset questions, `ambiguous` exactly the `asked_back` ones, `unanswerable` exactly the `unanswerable` truths, and a declared `forbidden` only on a question withheld from every persona it lists. A card that asks dataset questions names the kind of every question; other cards may leave them out.
- The runner stamps each turn's kind on its result (`askKind` on every question and dataset-question result). The scorecard counts the asks kind by kind (`HalfScores.kinds`) and adds `Run · kinds` / `Iterate · Run · kinds`, all ten kinds in order, a kind not asked shown as `0 asked`. `summary` sums the row. A card that names no kind, and an older record, show no row.
- `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` gains an "Ask kinds" section: the ten kinds with the rule each is held to, and the per-card count table (no kind at zero). A test holds the cards to the table's figures. It keeps them as a literal, because reading the README from the package's tests would be an undeclared cross-package input (`check:cross-package-test-inputs`).

| Kind | `order_to_cash` | `travel_expense` | Total |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| `count` | 3 | 3 | 6 |
| `group_sum` | 2 | 3 | 5 |
| `top_n` | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| `time_range` | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| `join` | 2 | 2 | 4 |
| `owner_latest` | 2 | 1 | 3 |
| `business_term` | 2 | 2 | 4 |
| `ambiguous` | 2 | 2 | 4 |
| `forbidden` | 1 | 2 | 3 |
| `unanswerable` | 1 | 1 | 2 |

**Card two (folded in): the step-2 approver in the `travel_expense` prose.** The detailed prompt said "the department manager first (a manager's own claim goes to the finance manager), then Finance". Finance has two members, and the same sentence names one of them the finance manager, so builds could route step 2 to that manager (e14). Every seeded step-2 row and the persona name the Finance officer (e13). The prose now reads "then a Finance officer (Finance staff other than the finance manager)", and the Chinese text says the same. The expected approver, the seed rows, the `$comment` and the `manager_approves_step_one` operation are unchanged. This follows the reading on that card (comment 7061940514, option B), in its own commit.

## Tests

- New top-level describes in the existing harnesses:
  - `test/dataset-cards.test.ts`: every question of both cards names a kind; across the cards no kind is asked fewer than twice; `department_budgets` is `forbidden` as `employee` and `group_sum` as `dept_manager`; each card's per-kind count equals the README table's figures; 18 refusal cases, each at its `askKind` path, including `owner_latest` on a status (`orders_by_status`) and on a product category across a lookup (`booked_by_category`); `owner_latest` across a lookup to a person (`overdue_by_owner`, `account.owner`) loads; a declared `forbidden` withheld from every listed persona loads; a card without dataset questions may name no kinds.
  - `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`: the offline ask round below; the `Run · kinds` row and the record's tally on a hand-built half; a card that names no kinds has no kinds tally and no row.

## Acceptance notes

- **Done-when, the round:** no live model round ran in this container. The live driver needs a permission mode other than Auto (packages README, "Permission mode"). The offline path ran instead: `runHalf` over each dataset card on the in-memory app, with a driver that answers questions from the computed truth and dataset questions with no route. Every turn's result carries its kind. `kindTally` matches the README counts, and `Run · kinds` names all ten kinds with a measured count on each card. The first live round on the verified build will show the row.
- **The FLS "not visible to you" question (comments 6971648229 and 6979780844):** #35179 shipped the framework half. `query_records` / `get_record` now name the withheld field for a caller served the whole schema (ADR-0106 D4) or on a deployment with masking off (D8). The open runner's personas are plain members (`create-user` with `role: 'user'`) on a default `objectstack dev` host, so the ruled caller cannot be asked on the open cards today. The existing `withheld` grader already passes "not visible to you" and fails "blank". What is missing is the caller: a schema-exempt persona, or a recorded masking-off round. That runner choice is not in this PR; the seat routes it as its own card. The README says no open card asks it yet. The `forbidden` turns here are the member leak reading under default masking.
- `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.provenance.json` records the card's new sha256 (`abe91b8f…` to `29162eef…`), following #35764. The build file is unchanged.
- The verified build `builds/travel_expense.json` was authored against the pre-#35098 prompt, which said "then Finance". Ask rounds install that build and do not re-author it, so the prose change reaches only scratch and door builds.
- Ask-round records split at both cards' new hashes (`summary` refuses to mix card hashes).

## Verification

- Read first: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/ask-kinds.ts` (`questionKindProblem`, `questionTurnKind`), then `kindTally` / `kindCell` in `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/scorecard.ts`, then the two cards' `askKind` lines.
- Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/dataset-cards.test.ts -t kind`. Expect 27 passed.
